id: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai (1999)

facts.text: Two coco. One for the girl.
facts.why: Raymond is a Haitian ice cream man who only speaks French. No source I opened mentions coconut ice cream or Ghost Dog buying two cones for Pearline.
facts.fix: Deux glaces. Une pour la petite.

fix_note.text: Deux glaces. Une pour la petite.

facts.text: the only flavour on Raymond's truck
facts.why: It clashes with the card's own 'Flavours of the Day' line, and no source I opened names coconut as Raymond's flavour.
facts.fix: Raymond and his ice cream truck in the park

vibe.verdict: A neat French and English ice cream stand with the pigeon coop, but it uses very little of the book, the pigeons or the mob cartoons.
missing: Ghost Dog's Hagakure passages (the chapter openers)
Pearline and the Frankenstein chat (the park)
Mob bosses watching cartoons (Betty Boop and the don)
Ghost Dog handing Pearline the Hagakure (the end)
The neighbour building a boat on his roof (used only as a caption)
ideas: Swap 'Green Soybeans' note for a Hagakure line chosen from the film, as a chapter heading.
Swap 'Roasted Nuts' for 'Pigeon Feed', for the coop on the roof.
Add a Betty Boop cartoon sticker in place of the plain label on the photo.
Swap 'Tablet Pistach' note for 'For Pearline, who read it twice'.
